subject.title: Slack: Include file attachment metadata in inbound message delivery to agents

question: Should OpenClaw add a shared cross-channel inbound attachment metadata contract, or keep Slack on placeholders, media paths, and `download-file`?
rationale: The useful fix changes the agent-facing channel/plugin contract rather than a Slack-only bug path, so maintainers need to choose the permanent API shape before implementation.

options.title: Add shared attachment metadata
options.body: Introduce a narrow `InboundAttachments`-style context shape, populate Slack metadata first, and keep existing media fields compatible.

options.title: Add Slack-only metadata
options.body: Expose only Slack file metadata faster, accepting cross-channel drift and likely later migration work.

options.title: Keep current behavior
options.body: Continue relying on placeholders, `MediaPath`/`MediaPaths`, docs, and `download-file` without adding a new metadata contract.

recommendation.title: Add shared attachment metadata
recommendation.body: Introduce a narrow `InboundAttachments`-style context shape, populate Slack metadata first, and keep existing media fields compatible.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter Steinberger has the strongest sampled history across Slack file fallback, token handling, and plugin-boundary decisions relevant to the API direction.
